model_annotation:
Both panels plot training reward trajectories as a function of optimization steps for two methods, with the x-axis labeled “Steps” on a linear scale from 0 to 500 and regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500. The y-axis in both panels is labeled “Training Rewards” on a linear scale; in the top panel it spans roughly 0.0 to 0.4 (with labeled ticks at about 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4), and in the bottom panel it spans roughly 0.0 to 0.2 (with labeled ticks at about 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2). In each panel there are two solid lines (no point markers) with semi-transparent shaded bands around them.

In the “Easy Training Set” panel (top), the blue solid line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” starts near 0.0 at step 0, rises to around 0.25 by about 100 steps, reaches roughly 0.34–0.36 by about 200 steps, and then continues with small oscillations around the mid–0.3 range through to step 500, ending around ~0.35. The red solid line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” also starts near 0.0 at step 0, increases to about 0.22–0.24 near 100 steps, reaches around 0.30–0.33 by about 200 steps, and then continues upward with fluctuations, reaching values around ~0.38–0.40 near the end of the range and ending close to ~0.40 at step 500.

In the “Hard Training Set” panel (bottom), the blue solid line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” begins slightly above zero (around ~0.02–0.03) near step 0, declines toward ~0.01 by roughly 50–80 steps, and then stays very close to 0.0 for the remainder of the x-range through step 500. The red solid line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” starts near 0.0 at step 0, rises to about ~0.10 by around 100 steps, increases further to roughly ~0.14–0.15 by about 200 steps, and then continues with oscillations and gradual upward movement, reaching around ~0.18–0.20 toward the end and ending near ~0.20 at step 500.
